title: App export
question: What does the trading helper load?
headline: Exported 2000 wallet track records (3012 in the top tier) and 31 market pages. Out of sample, the top tier's net side won in 100% of 15 markets (the market's own mid-life favourite: 87%).
notes: Wallet scores use every resolved market (the app looks forward from today), so historical market pages contain hindsight; the out-of-sample hit rate uses point-in-time tiers only.
